validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE + LOCATION + LENGTH + CAPACITY: confirmed via the sheet's own cited primary source, panoramakz.com (ав 20.02.2015, 'Филиал «КазАзота» запустил в эксплуатацию газовое месторождение Шагырлы-Шомышты'), read in full: it states the connecting pipeline ('соединительный газопровод') from the Shagyrly-Shomyshty field ties into the 'Central Asia–Center' (CAC) trunk system at the 389.5 km mark near the Beineu compressor station, quotes 'протяженность - 96,2 км' (length — 96.2 km, exact GEM match) and 'пропускная способность газопровода составляет 1,56 млрд. кубометров в год' (capacity — 1.56 bcm/y, exact GEM match), and dates the commissioning ('зазтил') to February 2015, matching StartYear1=2015. NOTE: the worklist's automated existing_ref_checks marked the Status/Length/Capacity cells against this same URL as FAIL ('data value not found') — that is a mechanical false negative, not a real defect: the search tokens were ASCII '96.20'/'1.56' but the source page (like all Russian-language sources) writes decimals with a comma ('96,2', '1,56'). I read the live page directly and confirm both values verbatim. INDEPENDENT SECOND SOURCE for length/route: OSM (batches/kazakhstan-gas/staging/recon-osm-20260811/) carries a NAMED trace 'месторождение Шагырлы-шомышты - компрессорная станция бейнеу' (ref_id osm:gas_kz:w291491982_294602571#2) with geodesic length 96.207 km — an exact match to GEM's 96.20 km, and match_diff.json scores it as an 'overlaps' match to P6789 (route IoU 0.654, length signal 1.0). Fourteen further OSM fragments (0.2–5 km each) are also matched FRAGMENT_OF_EXISTING against P6789's drawn route, consistent with a real, well-mapped short connector line — no red flags. So length is HIGH tier (2 independent: panoramakz + OSM geometry); capacity is MEDIUM tier (1 source — no second independent figure found for the exact 1.56 bcm/y throughput; the KazAzot field-output target of '>1 bcm/y' on kazazot.kz is a different metric (gas production, not pipe capacity) and does not corroborate it). ATTRIBUTION (Owner/Operator): KazAzot's own site (www.kazazot.kz/page/show/24, now dead — see caveat, read via Wayback: https://web.archive.org/web/2020id_/https://www.kazazot.kz/page/show/24) confirms in its own words that the field and its connecting pipeline exist to supply gas for «нужд АО «КазАзот»» (KazAzot's own needs) — fully consistent with Owner1 = 'KazAzot JSC' 100% and Operator = 'АО «КазАзот»'. This is a single-origin confirmation (medium tier) — no third-party ownership register found; but a company describing its own asset on its own site is strong evidence. DIAMETER: the SAME KazAzot page (Wayback) states the connecting pipeline is 'Æ530х8мм' — 530mm OD, 8mm wall — an exact match to GEM's Diameter=530mm. panoramakz does NOT mention diameter, so this is single-source (medium tier), but again the owner's own technical description. DUPLICATE CHECK against the 39-pipeline roster: no other row shares this field, these endpoints, or this length/capacity — P6789 is not a relabel of any other Kazakhstan gas pipeline; the CAC/Okarem-Beineu systems it ties into are separately and correctly tracked as P2291/P5770/P5771 (CAC) and P2492/P5772 (Okarem-Beineu), which is right since P6789 is upstream of both, a distinct short connector, not a segment of either. CLASSIFICATION CAVEAT (PipelineType='transmission'): panoramakz's own language calls this a 'соединительный газопровод' (connecting/feeder pipeline) linking a single field to the CAC trunk, not a 'магистральный' (trunk) line in its own right — GEM's controlled vocab (transmission/gathering/distribution) arguably fits 'gathering' at least as well as 'transmission' for a field-to-trunk tie-in. I am NOT unilaterally reclassifying it: the roster shows the same structural shape (single field or small cluster feeding a compressor station on a trunk) on P3946 Kozhasai-KS12, P3947 Karachaganak-Uralsk, and P6787 Sarybulak-Zimunay, all also carrying PipelineType='transmission' — this looks like a deliberate tracker-wide convention (large-diameter field-tie-in lines get 'transmission', 'gathering' reserved for in-field flowlines) rather than a P6789-specific error. Flagging for awareness/policy confirmation, not changing the value. REF-QUALITY CAVEAT: the current Status [ref] cell cites two URLs — panoramakz.com (good, discussed above) AND https://intergas.kz/ru. I fetched intergas.kz/ru directly: it is the corporate homepage of JSC 'Intergas Central Asia' (the CAC trunk operator, a DIFFERENT company from KazAzot) and contains no mention of KazAzot, Shagyrly-Shomyshty, or this pipeline at all — it is a generic/irrelevant citation that does not actually support this row's Status value (this matches the sweep's own standing rule: 'a row whose only support is a generic/aggregate citation that does not name this pipeline is itself an existence flag' — here it is not the ONLY support, panoramakz genuinely does support existence/status, but intergas.kz/ru should be dropped as noise, not kept as if it corroborates anything). Overall verdict: CONFIRMED (caveat) — real pipeline, correctly attributed, length/capacity/diameter all match the sheet's own or the owner's own primary sources; the only actionable items are two dead-ref citations (Diameter/Owner, both cite the now-404 kazazot.kz/page/show/24) and one noise citation (intergas.kz/ru on Status) to clean up.
